model.name: One DnD: every folder is a drop target, a drop places a LINK to the one stored unit; REMOVE unlinks, DELETE (red) removes the unit + all links
model.description: Tron design statement 2026-09-06 (verbatim): 'one DND for all folders as dropTargets everywhere. dropping something in either places a link to the centralized storage scenario unit always... no matter if file, image, task, modelElement or whatever oop object. we also need a remove button on every file in the action bar and a delete button that is red and really removes from the index and removes all links... (dangerous)'. THE MODEL: (1) EVERY FOLDER EVERYWHERE is a drop target via ONE contract, no per-surface variants (room files / model tree / diagrams / traceability). (2) A DROP places a LINK to the ONE centralized storage unit — ALWAYS, never a copy — for ANY OOP object (file/image/task/modelElement/requirement/whatever). One unit, many links = identity by reference (same law as the one-store root R40.81). (3) REMOVE (on every file in the action bar) unlinks THIS link only; the unit + its other links survive. (4) DELETE (RED, DANGEROUS) really removes the unit FROM THE INDEX and removes ALL its links everywhere.
model.tronQuote: > Tron 2026-09-06: 'one DND for all folders as dropTargets everywhere. dropping something in either places a link to the centralized storage scenario unit always... no matter if file, image, task, modelElement or whatever oop object. we also need a remove button on every file in the action bar and a delete button that is red and really removes from the index and removes all links... (dangerous)'.

discoverySource.note: Design statement, not a suggestion. Drop=link (identity by reference, R40.81 law); remove=unlink-this; delete=remove-unit-and-all-links (dangerous).

model.queuePriority: TIER-A (object-action lane; the drop/link/remove/delete model over R37.20 + R40.86).
model.designQuestionToArchitect: How LINK (this req) relates to the MOVE/re-parent shipped tonight (R40.86 folder re-parent): they MAY compose as move = link-here + unlink-there. PO routed this to the ARCHITECT to resolve (ours, not Tron's to adjudicate). Do NOT resolve at req level; the architect rules the composition.
model.crossRefNote: Drop model over the ONE contract (R37.20 = buffer carries the unit; this = a drop places a LINK to it). Folders-as-targets = R40.86. Identity-by-reference (one unit, many links) = the same law as the one-store root R40.81. REMOVE/DELETE join the action family with R40.104 (rename) + R40.105 (naming). ARCHITECT resolves LINK-vs-MOVE composition (designQuestionToArchitect).

acceptanceCriteria.text: LINK is the PRIMITIVE (=drop, Tron 'places a link ALWAYS'): a drop ADDS ONE EDGE (a container children[] ref) — never a copy, and it NEVER mutates the unit body. A unit in N containers = N edges. ASSERT: after 2 drops of the same unit into 2 folders, the same uuid appears in both + the unit body is BYTE-IDENTICAL (0 new stored units).

gateRef.assertion: a drop adds exactly one children[] edge, +0 stored units, unit body byte-unchanged; a drop that copies the unit or mutates its body => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a drop that copies the unit (or mutates its body) instead of adding an edge -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The SAME unit linked in N folders is ONE unit, N EDGES: uuid identical, content stored ONCE, unit body byte-identical across all containers (containment is a many-to-many edge set, identity by reference = R40.81 law).

gateRef.assertion: same unit in N containers = 1 stored unit + N edges, body byte-identical; a 2nd stored copy for the 2nd edge => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed the same unit linked in 2 folders stored as 2 units -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: REMOVE (on every file in the action bar) unlinks HERE only: this link is removed, the unit and its OTHER links survive and still resolve elsewhere.

gateRef.assertion: after REMOVE in folder A, the link is gone from A but the unit still resolves via its link in folder B; REMOVE deleting the unit or breaking another link => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a REMOVE that deletes the unit (or breaks another link) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: DELETE (RED, dangerous) destroys the unit from the index AND scan-unlinks ALL its edges everywhere. ASSERT via the graph-integrity walker: ZERO dangling refs after (no edge/ref anywhere points at the dead uuid). RECOVERABLE: the pre-image is committed to git before the destroy (his data is never unrecoverably lost).

gateRef.assertion: after DELETE: unit gone + every edge removed (graph-integrity walker: 0 dangling) AND a git pre-image commit exists; a surviving ref at the dead uuid OR no pre-image => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a DELETE that leaves a dangling edge OR does not commit a pre-image -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: DELETE is visually RED and requires an EXPLICIT confirm (it is destructive on the owner's real data). REMOVE (unlink) is NOT red and needs no confirm.

gateRef.assertion: the DELETE action renders RED + gates on an explicit confirm; a delete that fires without red styling or without confirm => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a DELETE that executes without the red styling or without a confirm -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: EVERY folder EVERYWHERE is a drop target via the ONE shared drop contract (R37.20) — NO per-surface variants: room files, /model tree, diagrams, traceability all use the same contract for drop/link/remove/delete.

gateRef.assertion: every folder surface routes drop/link/remove/delete through the one contract; a folder surface with its own drop/link/remove/delete variant => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a folder surface with its own drop-target variant (not the shared contract) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Drop-as-link + remove + delete are registered PER CLASS, so a NEW object kind gains ALL of it with ZERO central-switch edits — both open-set and closed-set lints stay 0 (no if/switch enumerating object kinds for drop/link/remove/delete).

gateRef.assertion: adding an object kind requires no central-switch edit; a switch/if-chain enumerating kinds for drop/link/remove/delete => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a central switch enumerating object kinds for drop/remove/delete -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Containment is the many-to-many EDGE set (container children[] refs) — the SINGLE truth. parentFolder (singular) is RETIRED as a containment source; containment DERIVES from edges, never from a singular parentFolder field.

gateRef.assertion: containment/membership reads resolve from the children[] edge set; a read of parentFolder (singular) as the containment source => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a containment read from parentFolder (singular) instead of the edge set -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: MOVE (re-parent, R40.86) is DERIVED = unlink(source) + link(target); it performs NO containment mutation of its own. The R40.86 bespoke reparent body is RETIRED and re-expressed as this composition. ASSERT: 0 parentFolder/containment mutations outside link/unlink; reparentUnitsIntoContainer's body is deleted/reduced to link+unlink.

gateRef.assertion: move performs no containment mutation outside link/unlink; a bespoke reparent body mutating containment directly => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a reparent/move that mutates containment directly (not via link+unlink) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: SAFE TRANSITION, TWO DIFFERENTIALS (architect CORRECTED render-measurement 9a0be1577 — all 30 parentFolder targets are ROOMS, membership markers, not sub-folder pointers): (a) TRANSPARENCY 0-delta on the ~6893 edge-based units AND the 25 redundant-parentFolder units (parentFolder==own room + already in files[] -> render at root CORRECTLY; retire changes NOTHING); any delta on these => RED. (b) FIX differential on the 5 units (parentFolder=room 3231db71 but NOT in its files[] = INVISIBLE): 4 restored to room 3231db71 fileUnits (invisible->visible) + 1 junk (about:blank#blocked) DELETED; per-uuid; a 0-delta on a real invisible OR a change to any of the 25 OR a 6th unit => RED. parentFolder retired only after both pass; git pre-image first. (CORRECTED from the earlier 25+5 assumption — the 25 are NOT a defect.)

gateRef.assertion: (a) ~6893 edge-based + the 25 redundant: 0 render delta on retire, else RED; (b) the 5 invisible: exactly 4-restore-to-room-3231db71 + 1-junk-delete, per-uuid; 0-delta on a real one OR any change to the 25 or a 6th => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: (a) seed a transparency unit (or one of the 25) changing render on retire -> RED; (b) seed a real invisible left unrendered, OR the junk restored, OR a 6th unit touched -> RED
